goal.insight: Visually align and overlay the NASDAQ trajectory, P/E ratio, IPO count, and corporate earnings for the 1997–2002 dot-com era against the 2021–2024 AI era so viewers can judge whether the two episodes share a similar shape
Highlight the comparative magnitude of P/E ratios between the two periods, making it easy to see how current valuations stack up against the dot-com peak
Emphasize the difference in IPO volume patterns between the two eras, showing whether the AI period exhibits a comparable surge in new listings
Show aggregate NASDAQ corporate earnings as a backdrop to valuations in both periods, making it visually clear whether earnings growth supports or contradicts the price run-up
Mark the dot-com NASDAQ peak (March 2000) and the AI-era recent high on the aligned timeline so viewers can anchor the comparison around climax points
